data.description: Follow-up from hive-flow-9331 Slice B. Cursor read-only-with-artifacts currently fails closed to plan/no-edit mode because cursor has no proven OS write-confinement equivalent to codex workspace-write. Before any cursor temp+copy-back support is allowed, empirically prove cursor --sandbox prevents absolute-path writes from escaping a private temp workspace. Include filesystem-checked inside/outside/root/sibling results and update cursor provider mapping only if confinement is proven.
